pre_command:
osascript -e 'tell application "Notes" to quit' && sleep 2 && osascript -e 'tell application "Notes"
    try
        set recipesFolder to folder "Recipes"
        delete recipesFolder
        return "True"
    on error
        return "False"
    end try
end tell'
instruction: Within Notes, create a new folder called 'Recipes'. Then, inside this folder, create a note titled 'Chocolate Cake Recipe' and add the following content: list the ingredients 'Flour, Sugar, Cocoa, Eggs, Butter' and include the instruction 'Mix all together and bake for 30 minutes'.
evaluator:
osascript -e 'tell application "Notes"
    try
        set recipesFolder to folder "Recipes"
        set cakeNote to note "Chocolate Cake Recipe" in recipesFolder
        set noteContent to body of cakeNote
        set requiredIngredients to {"Flour", "Sugar", "Cocoa", "Eggs", "Butter"}
        set allIngredientsFound to true
        repeat with ingredient in requiredIngredients
            if noteContent does not contain ingredient then
                set allIngredientsFound to false
                exit repeat
            end if
        end repeat
        set instructionFound to (noteContent contains "Mix all together and bake for 30 minutes")
        if allIngredientsFound and instructionFound then
            return "True"
        else
            return "False"
        end if
    on error
        return "False"
    end try
end tell'
